discordPostHtml:
A domain-era corporation specialising in advanced automated defence systems.

v0.8.0
-new ships
    -kilroy-class cruiser
    -bannerman-class cruiser
    -hamis-class destroyer
-some big resprites
-new hullmods
-no new campaign content
-maybe fixed stuff idk been a while

I've done a fair bit of playtesting so crashes should be rare but definitely still possible. Campaign rework is still wip so this is just a content update for the new ships plus some balancing and stuff.

Requires the CMUtils mod as a dependency!
Download: https://github.com/automatopaste/pearson_exotronics/releases/download/v0.8.0/PearsonExotronics_v0.8.0.zip
Forum: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=18660.0
